title: Scrapbook: benefit game and Mardi Gras bands
summary: A 1949 benefit game with Tom Brown and Harry Shields, and Bergen on market Mardi Gras bands.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Mm-hmm. I see the Shell Gymnasium in Norco. Here's a little flower of Jesus Church at Clay. Different places. Here's a benefit ball game. And 49 November the 3rd.
Yeah, that's when I heard Tom Brown and I guess Harry Shields. Harry Shields was working for the railroad dinner shed. I remember that, yeah. That was in the day or night?
It was daytime at night. That's wrong, huh?
It says 7.30 p.m. Because I remember. It was definitely at night. It was daytime. Yeah. I must have changed it then. And you played for Carnival for a long time.
Every market used to have a band and a little amateur show, Mardi Gras Band. In the old days, it's all been stopped then.
